name: Bauble
author: Erin Carter
description: A single crystal ball filling the frame — a glass sphere refracting and reflecting a palette-tinted environment, its heart clouded with slow swirling smoke, a crisp studio highlight and a bright fresnel rim where the edge catches light. Reads as a real rendered glass orb.

params.label: Swirl
params.effect: Speed of the smoke drifting inside the orb; 0 holds the interior still.

params.label: Cloud
params.effect: Thickness of the interior swirl; 0 is clear glass, high fills the heart with cloud.

params.label: Polish
params.effect: Surface gloss — sharpness and brightness of the studio highlight.

params.label: Orb size
params.effect: How much of the frame the orb fills; high crops in close, low pulls it back into the field.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the view; 0 ignores the mouse.
